title.en: Volume 33: Wang Sengru; Zhang Shuai; Liu Xiaochuo
title.raw: 卷三十三 列傳第二十七 王僧孺 張率 劉孝綽 王筠 Volume 33: Wang Sengru; Zhang Shuai; Liu Xiaochuo

sentences.zh: 梁書卷第三十三 列傳第二十七

translations.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 33, Biographies 27
translations.idiomatic: Book of Liang, Volume 33, Biography 27

sentences.zh: 王僧孺 張率 劉孝綽 王筠

translations.literal: Wang Sengru; Zhang Shuai; Liu Xiaochuo; Wang Yun
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sengru, Zhang Shuai, Liu Xiaochuo, and Wang Yun

sentences.zh: 王僧孺字僧孺，東海郯人，魏衛將軍肅八世孫。

translations.literal: Wang Sengru, styled Sengru, was a native of Tan in Donghai, eighth-generation descendant of Su, General of the Guard of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sengru, whose courtesy name was Sengru, came from Tan in Donghai and was the eighth-generation descendant of Su, a General of the Guard under Wei.

sentences.zh: 曾祖雅，晉左光祿大夫、儀同三司。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Ya was Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness of Jin and Companionship Equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Ya had served the Jin as Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and as Companionship Equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 祖准，宋司徒左長史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zhun was Left Chief Clerk to the Minister over the Masses of Song.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zhun had been Left Chief Clerk to the Song Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 僧孺年五歲，讀《孝經》，問授者此書所載述，曰：「論忠孝二事。

translations.literal: At age five Sengru read the Classic of Filial Piety and asked his instructor what the book set forth; he was told, "It discusses the two matters of loyalty and filial piety."
translations.idiomatic: When Sengru was five, he was reading the Classic of Filial Piety and asked his teacher what the book was about. The teacher said, "It treats loyalty and filial piety."

sentences.zh: 」僧孺曰：「若爾，常願讀之。

translations.literal: " Sengru said, "If that is so, I shall always wish to read it."
translations.idiomatic: " Sengru replied, "If that is the case, I shall always want to read it."

sentences.zh: 」六歲能屬文，旣長好學。

translations.literal: " At six he could compose literary pieces; when grown he loved learning.
translations.idiomatic: " By six he could compose prose, and as he grew older he became devoted to study.

sentences.zh: 家貧，常傭書以養母，所寫旣畢，諷誦亦通。

translations.literal: His family was poor; he often copied books for hire to support his mother, and when he had finished writing them he could also recite them from memory.
translations.idiomatic: The family was poor, so he often hired himself out as a copyist to support his mother; once he had finished copying a text, he could recite it from memory as well.

sentences.zh: 仕齊，起家王國左常侍、太學博士。

translations.literal: He entered service under Qi, beginning his career as Left Regular Attendant of a princely state and Erudite of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: He took office under the Qi, beginning as Left Regular Attendant in a princely establishment and as Erudite of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射王晏深相賞好。

translations.literal: Wang Yan, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, deeply appreciated and favored him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, took a strong liking to him.

sentences.zh: 晏爲丹陽尹，召補郡功曹，使僧孺撰《東宮新記》。

translations.literal: When Yan became Prefect of Danyang, he summoned Sengru to fill the post of Commandery Merit Officer and had him compile the New Records of the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan became Prefect of Danyang, he appointed Sengru Commandery Merit Officer and commissioned him to compile the New Records of the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 遷大司馬豫章王行參軍，又兼太學博士。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Acting Adjutant on the staff of the Prince of Yuzhang, Grand Marshal, and also served concurrently as Erudite of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Acting Adjutant on the staff of the Prince of Yuzhang, Grand Marshal, while retaining a concurrent post as university erudite.

sentences.zh: 司徒竟陵王子良開西邸招文學，僧孺亦遊焉。

translations.literal: Zixiang, Prince of Jingling and Minister over the Masses, opened a Western Lodge to recruit men of letters, and Sengru also joined the gathering there.
translations.idiomatic: Zixiang, Prince of Jingling and Minister over the Masses, opened a Western Lodge for literary men, and Sengru joined the circle as well.

sentences.zh: 文惠太子聞其名，召入東宮，直崇明殿。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Wenhuì heard his name and summoned him into the Eastern Palace to serve on duty at Chongming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When Crown Prince Wenhuì heard of him, he summoned Sengru to the Eastern Palace and assigned him duty at Chongming Hall.

sentences.zh: 欲擬爲宮僚，文惠薨，不果。

translations.literal: He was about to be appointed a palace aide, but when Wenhuì died the plan came to nothing.
translations.idiomatic: He was slated to become a palace aide, but Crown Prince Wenhuì died before the appointment could be made.

sentences.zh: 時王晏子德元出爲晉安郡，以僧孺補郡丞，除候官令。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Yan's son Deyuan went out as administrator of Jin'an commandery and had Sengru fill the post of commandery aide; he was then appointed Magistrate of Houguan.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Yan's son Deyuan took up the Jin'an commandery, he appointed Sengru commandery aide and later had him made magistrate of Houguan.

sentences.zh: 建武初，有詔舉士，揚州刺史始安王遙光表薦秘書丞王暕及僧孺曰：「前候官令東海王僧孺，年三十五，理尚棲約，思致悟敏，旣筆耕爲養，亦傭書成學。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jianwu era an edict was issued to recommend scholars; Yao Guang, Prince of Shi'an and Inspector of Yangzhou, memorialized recommending Secretariat Aide Wang Sui and Sengru, saying: "The former Magistrate of Houguan, Wang Sengru of Donghai, is thirty-five years old. His principles incline toward simplicity and restraint, and his thoughts are keen and quick. He has supported himself by the pen and also completed his learning through copying books."
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jianwu reign an edict called for recommended scholars. Yao Guang, Prince of Shi'an and Yangzhou inspector, recommended Secretariat Aide Wang Sui and Sengru in a memorial: "The former magistrate of Houguan, Wang Sengru of Donghai, is thirty-five. His mind favors simplicity and restraint, and his intellect is sharp and nimble. He has supported his family by writing and built his learning by copying books."

sentences.zh: 至乃照螢映雪，編蒲緝柳，先言往行，人物雅俗，甘泉遺儀，南宮故事，畫地成圖，抵掌可述；

translations.literal: He has read by firefly light and snow-gleam, woven sedge and plaited willow; he can speak first of past conduct, of persons refined and vulgar, of the surviving rites of Sweet Springs and the precedents of the Southern Palace; he can draw a map on the ground and recount it with a clap of the hands;
translations.idiomatic: He has studied by firefly light and by snow-reflected glow, woven sedge mats and plaited willow slips; he can discourse on past conduct and on men both refined and common, on the rites preserved from Sweet Springs and the precedents of the Southern Palace; he can sketch a map on the ground and explain it with a gesture;

sentences.zh: 豈直鼮鼠有必對之辯，竹書無落簡之謬，訪對不休，質疑斯在。

translations.literal: how much more can he match the ready replies of the flying squirrel and keep the bamboo documents free of dropped slips—his questioning and answering never cease, and his power to resolve doubts is manifest."
translations.idiomatic: and he is no less ready than the proverbial flying squirrel with its unerring retorts, nor less careful than the keeper of bamboo documents who never drops a slip. His exchanges in inquiry never flag, and his answers to hard questions are always at hand."

sentences.zh: 」除尚書儀曹郎，遷治書侍御史，出爲錢唐令。

translations.literal: " He was appointed Gentleman of the Ceremonial Section of the Masters of Writing, transferred to Attending Censor of Investigative Documents, and sent out as Magistrate of Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: " He was made Gentleman of the Ceremonial Section in the Masters of Writing, promoted to Attending Censor of Investigative Documents, and then sent out as magistrate of Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 初，僧孺與樂安任昉遇竟陵王西邸，以文學友會，及是將之縣，昉贈詩，其略曰：「惟子見知，惟余知子。

translations.literal: Earlier Sengru and Ren Fang of Le'an had met at the Western Lodge of the Prince of Jingling and formed a literary friendship; when Sengru was about to take up his county post, Fang presented a parting poem, of which the gist runs: "You alone know me; I alone know you."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Sengru and Ren Fang of Le'an had met at the Prince of Jingling's Western Lodge and become literary friends. When Sengru was leaving for his county post, Fang gave him a farewell poem that begins: "You alone have known me; I alone have known you."

sentences.zh: 觀行視言，要終猶始。

translations.literal: Watch conduct, weigh words—the end should be as the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Judge conduct and weigh words: the end must match the beginning.

sentences.zh: 敬之重之，如蘭如芷。

translations.literal: Honor him, esteem him—as orchid, as iris.
translations.idiomatic: Honor him and esteem him, as one would orchid or iris.

sentences.zh: 形應影隨，曩行今止。

translations.literal: Form answers shadow; what once moved now stops.
translations.idiomatic: Body answers shadow; the journey we once shared now halts.

sentences.zh: 百行之首，立人斯著。

translations.literal: The first of the hundred conduct—by it a man is established.
translations.idiomatic: It stands first among the hundred virtues by which a man is made.

sentences.zh: 子之有之，誰毀誰譽。

translations.literal: You possess it—who can slander, who can praise away?
translations.idiomatic: You possess it—who could slander you, who could praise you into something else?

sentences.zh: 修名旣立，老至何遽。

translations.literal: Your cultivated name is already established—why should old age come so soon?
translations.idiomatic: Your good name is already established—why should old age arrive so quickly?

sentences.zh: 誰其執鞭，吾爲子御。

translations.literal: Who will hold the whip? I will drive for you.
translations.idiomatic: Who will hold the whip? I shall be your driver.

sentences.zh: 劉《略》班《藝》，虞《志》荀《錄》，伊昔有懷，交相欣勗。

translations.literal: Liu's Summary, Ban's Treatise on the Arts, Yu's Records, Xun's Register—in former days we cherished these and urged each other on in delight.
translations.idiomatic: Liu's Summary, Ban's Treatise on the Arts, Yu's Records, Xun's Register—in days past we shared these ambitions and urged each other on with mutual delight.

sentences.zh: 下帷無倦，升高有屬。

translations.literal: Behind lowered curtains, never weary; climbing higher, there is one to join you.
translations.idiomatic: Study behind lowered curtains without weariness; as you rise, there will be one to follow you.

sentences.zh: 嘉爾晨燈，惜余夜燭。

translations.literal: I praise your morning lamp and regret my night candle."
translations.idiomatic: I praise your lamp at dawn and grieve that my candle must burn alone at night."

sentences.zh: 」其爲士友推重如此。

translations.literal: " In this way he was esteemed and honored by fellow scholars.
translations.idiomatic: " Such was the esteem in which his fellow scholars held him.

sentences.zh: 天監初，除臨川王後軍記室參軍，待詔文德省。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Tianjian era he was appointed Recorder on the staff of the Rear Army of the Prince of Linchuan and awaited edicts in the Wende Office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianjian reign he was made Recorder on the staff of the Prince of Linchuan's rear army and served as an edict-awaiting scribe in the Wende Office.

sentences.zh: 尋出爲南海太守。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he went out as Administrator of Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was sent out as administrator of Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 郡常有高涼生口及海舶每歲數至，外國賈人以通貨易。

translations.literal: The commandery regularly had captives from Gaoliang and several seagoing ships each year; foreign merchants came to trade goods.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the commandery regularly received captives from Gaoliang and several ocean-going vessels, and foreign merchants came to trade their goods.

sentences.zh: 舊時州郡以半價就市，又買而卽賣，其利數倍，歷政以爲常。

translations.literal: In former times prefectures and commanderies bought at half price in the market, then bought and immediately resold, multiplying the profit several times over; successive administrations treated this as routine.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the prefectural and commandery offices would buy at half price in the market, then resell at once for several times the profit, and successive administrations had treated this as normal practice.

sentences.zh: 僧孺乃歎曰：「昔人爲蜀部長史，終身無蜀物，吾欲遺子孫者，不在越裝。

translations.literal: Sengru sighed and said, "In former times a man served as Chief Clerk of the Shu region and through his whole life owned nothing from Shu; what I wish to leave my descendants is not found in Yue goods."
translations.idiomatic: Sengru sighed and said, "In antiquity a man served as chief clerk of the Shu region and through his whole life kept no goods from Shu. What I wish to leave my descendants is not to be found among the treasures of Yue."

sentences.zh: 」並無所取。

translations.literal: " He took nothing at all.
translations.idiomatic: " He took none of it for himself.

sentences.zh: 視事朞月，有詔徵還，郡民道俗六百人詣闕請留，不許。

translations.literal: After one month in office an edict summoned him back; six hundred lay and clerical people of the commandery went to the capital to request that he be kept, but permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: After a month in office an edict recalled him to court. Six hundred lay and clerical residents of the commandery went to the capital to ask that he be retained, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 旣至，拜中書郎、領著作，復直文德省，撰《中表簿》及《起居注》。

translations.literal: When he arrived he was appointed Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat and put in charge of the Bureau of Compilation; he again served on duty in the Wende Office and compiled the Register of Central Genealogies and the Daily Records.
translations.idiomatic: On his arrival he was made Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat and placed in charge of the Bureau of Compilation. He again served in the Wende Office and compiled the Register of Central Genealogies and the Daily Records.

sentences.zh: 遷尚書左丞，領著作如故。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing while retaining charge of compilation as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing while continuing to head the Bureau of Compilation as before.

sentences.zh: 俄除遊擊將軍，兼御史中丞。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed General of Mobile Strikes and concurrently served as Imperial Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made General of Mobile Strikes and concurrently appointed Imperial Censor.

sentences.zh: 僧孺幼貧，其母鬻紗布以自業，嘗攜僧孺至市，道遇中丞鹵簿，驅迫溝中。

translations.literal: Sengru had been poor in childhood; his mother sold gauze and cloth to make her living and once took Sengru to market. On the road they met the guard escort of an imperial censor, who drove them into a ditch.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru had grown up poor. His mother sold gauze and cloth for a living and once took him to market. On the road they met the escort of an imperial censor, whose attendants forced them into a ditch.

sentences.zh: 及是拜日，引騶清道，悲感不自勝。

translations.literal: On the day of this appointment he had outriders clear the road and was overcome with grief he could not master.
translations.idiomatic: On the day he received this appointment he had outriders clear the road before him and was overcome with emotion he could not contain.

sentences.zh: 尋以公事降爲雲騎將軍，兼職如故，頃之卽真。

translations.literal: Soon, on account of official business, he was demoted to General of Cloud Cavalry while his concurrent posts remained as before; shortly afterward he received full appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because of an official matter, he was demoted to General of Cloud Cavalry while retaining his concurrent posts; before long he received full confirmation in the rank.

sentences.zh: 是時高祖制《春景明志詩》五百字，敕在朝之人沈約已下同作，高祖以僧孺詩爲工。

translations.literal: At that time the High Ancestor composed a five-hundred-character poem titled Spring Scenery and Clarified Intent and ordered those at court, from Shen Yue downward, to compose in the same form; the High Ancestor judged Sengru's poem the most accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Wu composed a five-hundred-character poem, "Spring Scenery and Clarified Intent," and ordered those at court, from Shen Yue on down, to compose matching pieces. The emperor judged Sengru's poem the finest.

sentences.zh: 遷少府卿，出監吳郡。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Palace Provisionery and sent out to oversee Wu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Director of the Palace Provisionery and sent out to oversee Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 還除尚書吏部郎，參大選，請謁不行。

translations.literal: On his return he was appointed Gentleman of the Personnel Section of the Masters of Writing, took part in the great selections, and would not accept private audiences.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made Gentleman of the Personnel Section and took part in the major appointments. He refused to entertain private solicitations.

sentences.zh: 出爲仁威南康王長史，行府、州、國事。

translations.literal: He went out as Chief Clerk to Renwei, Prince of Nankang, and acted in the affairs of the princely establishment, the prefecture, and the state.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as chief clerk to Renwei, Prince of Nankang, and administered the affairs of the princely establishment, the prefecture, and the fief.

sentences.zh: 王典簽湯道愍暱於王，用事府內，僧孺每裁抑之，道愍遂謗訟僧孺，逮詣南司。

translations.literal: The prince's Master of Documents Tang Daomin was intimate with the prince and wielded power within the establishment; Sengru repeatedly checked and restrained him, whereupon Daomin slandered and prosecuted Sengru, who was seized and sent to the Southern Tribunal.
translations.idiomatic: The prince's Master of Documents, Tang Daomin, was on intimate terms with the prince and controlled affairs within the establishment. Sengru repeatedly curbed him, so Daomin slandered and prosecuted him, and Sengru was seized and brought before the Southern Tribunal.

sentences.zh: 奉箋辭府曰：「下官不能避溺山隅，而正冠李下，旣貽疵辱，方致徽繩，解籙收簪，且歸初服。

translations.literal: He submitted a note resigning from the establishment, saying: "Your subordinate could not avoid drowning at a mountain corner yet straighten his cap beneath a plum tree; having already brought on disgrace, he now faces the binding cord. He removes his register and puts away his hairpin and for the present returns to his former garb."
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial resigning from the establishment: "Your servant could not avoid drowning in a mountain pool yet still straighten his cap under a plum tree. Having already brought disgrace upon himself, he now faces the binding cord. I surrender my register, lay aside my official pin, and return for now to my former dress."

sentences.zh: 竊以董生偉器，止相驕王；

translations.literal: I venture to think that Master Dong, a great vessel, served only as tutor to a proud prince;
translations.idiomatic: I reflect that Dong Zhongshu, a man of great capacity, served only as tutor to a proud prince;

sentences.zh: 賈子上才，爰傅卑土。

translations.literal: Jia Yi, a superior talent, was made tutor to lowly soil.
translations.idiomatic: and Jia Yi, a man of outstanding talent, was made tutor to a prince of humble standing.

sentences.zh: 下官生年有值，謬仰清塵，假翼西雍，竊步東閣，多慚袨服，取亂長裾，高榻相望，直居坐右，長階如畫，獨在僚端。

translations.literal: Your subordinate, born in a fortunate age, wrongly looked up to your clear dust, borrowed wings in the Western Yong, stole steps in the Eastern Pavilion, often ashamed in ceremonial dress and trailing the long hem; with high couches facing one another he served on duty at the right seat, on the long steps like a painting he stood alone at the head of the staff.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant, born in a fortunate age, wrongly aspired to follow in your wake, borrowed wings in the Western Yong, and stole a place in the Eastern Pavilion. Often ashamed in full dress and trailing the long hem of court, he sat on duty at the high couch to your right and alone at the head of the painted steps among the staff.

sentences.zh: 借其從容之詞，假以寬和之色，恩禮遠過申、白，榮望多厠應、徐。

translations.literal: Borrowing your easy words and your mild and harmonious countenance, the favor shown me far surpassed Shen and Bai, and the honor hoped for often matched Ying and Xu.
translations.idiomatic: By your easy words and your mild, gracious bearing, the favor shown me far surpassed what Shen Buhai or Gongsun Bai received, and the honor I hoped for often rivaled that of Ying Qu and Xu Gan.

sentences.zh: 厚德難逢，小人易說。

translations.literal: Deep virtue is hard to meet; petty men are easy to persuade.
translations.idiomatic: Deep virtue is hard to encounter; petty men are easy to sway.

sentences.zh: 方謂離腸隕首，不足以報一言；

translations.literal: I had thought that tearing my entrails and losing my head would not suffice to repay a single word;
translations.idiomatic: I had thought that to tear out my entrails and give up my life would not suffice to repay a single word of yours;

sentences.zh: 露膽披誠，何能以酬屢顧。

translations.literal: to bare my liver and lay open my sincerity—how could that repay your repeated regard?
translations.idiomatic: to bare my heart and lay open my sincerity—how could that repay your repeated regard?

sentences.zh: 寧謂罻羅裁舉，微禽先落；

translations.literal: Who would have thought that when the fine net was spread the small bird would fall first;
translations.idiomatic: Who would have thought that when the fine net was cast, the smallest bird would fall first;

sentences.zh: 閶闔始吹，細草仍墜。

translations.literal: when the Gate of Heaven had only begun to blow, the slender grass still dropped.
translations.idiomatic: that when the Gate of Heaven had only begun to stir, the tender grass would already be struck down?

sentences.zh: 一辭九畹，方去五雲。

translations.literal: With one farewell to the nine orchid beds, I am just now leaving the five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: With one farewell to the orchid beds of the palace, I am only now departing the five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 縱天網是漏，聖恩可恃，亦復孰寄心骸，何施眉目。

translations.literal: Even if Heaven's net has gaps and sagely favor may be relied on, to whom again can I entrust body and heart, and before whom can I show my face?
translations.idiomatic: Even if Heaven's net has gaps and your sage grace may still be trusted, to whom can I now entrust body and heart, and before whom can I show my face?

sentences.zh: 方當橫潭亂海，就魚鱉而爲羣；

translations.literal: I am about to cross muddied pools and churned seas and join fish and turtles in their throng;
translations.idiomatic: I am about to wander through muddied pools and churned seas and take my place among fish and turtles;

sentences.zh: 披榛捫樹，從虺蛇而相伍。

translations.literal: push through brambles and feel along trees and keep company with adders and serpents.
translations.idiomatic: push through brambles, grope along the trees, and keep company with adders and serpents.

sentences.zh: 豈復仰聽金聲，式瞻玉色。

translations.literal: How can I again look up to hear your golden voice or gaze upon your jade countenance?
translations.idiomatic: How can I again look up to hear your golden voice or gaze upon your jade countenance?

sentences.zh: 顧步高軒，悲如霰委；

translations.literal: Turning back at the high hall, my grief falls like hail;
translations.idiomatic: As I turn back from your high hall, grief falls like hail;

sentences.zh: 踟躕下席，淚若綆縻。」

translations.literal: hesitating as I leave the lower seat, tears like a tangled cord."
translations.idiomatic: and as I linger below your seat, my tears bind me like a tangled cord."

sentences.zh: 僧孺坐免官，久之不調。

translations.literal: Sengru was dismissed from office on this charge and for a long time received no new appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru was dismissed from office on this charge and went for a long time without a new appointment.

sentences.zh: 友人廬江何炯猶爲王府記室，乃致書於炯，以見其意。

translations.literal: His friend He Jiong of Lujiang was still Recorder in a princely establishment, and Sengru sent him a letter to make his feelings known.
translations.idiomatic: His friend He Jiong of Lujiang was still serving as a princely recorder, and Sengru wrote to him to express what he felt.

sentences.zh: 曰：

translations.literal: It reads:
translations.idiomatic: It reads:

sentences.zh: 近別之後，將隔暄寒，思子爲勞，未能忘弭。

translations.literal: After our recent parting we shall be separated by warm and cold seasons; thinking of you is labor, and I cannot forget or lay it aside.
translations.idiomatic: Since our recent parting we shall be separated by many seasons of warmth and cold. Thoughts of you weary me, and I cannot put them aside.

sentences.zh: 昔李叟入秦，梁生適越，猶懷悵恨，且或吟謠；

translations.literal: In former times when the old man of Li entered Qin and the man of Liang went to Yue, they still harbored regret and sometimes even sang verses;
translations.idiomatic: In former times, when the old man of Li went into Qin and the man of Liang went to Yue, they still felt regret and sometimes even composed verses;

sentences.zh: 況歧路之日，將離嚴網，辭無可憐，罪有不測。

translations.literal: how much more on a day of diverging roads, when I am about to leave the strict net—my words win no pity, and my offense admits no measure.
translations.idiomatic: how much more now, on a day of parting roads, when I am about to leave the strict net of the law—my words win no pity, and my offense admits no reckoning.

sentences.zh: 蓋畫地刻木，昔人所惡，叢棘旣累，於何可聞，所以握手戀戀，離別珍重。

translations.literal: To draw on the ground or carve in wood was what men of old detested; now that the thorn thicket has piled up, how can one be heard? Therefore we clasp hands with lingering affection and part with mutual regard.
translations.idiomatic: To draw on the ground or carve in wood was what men of old detested. Now that the thicket of thorns has closed in, how can one be heard? That is why we clasp hands with lingering affection and part with mutual regard.

sentences.zh: 弟愛同鄒季，淫淫承睫，吾猶復抗手分背，羞學婦人。

translations.literal: You, my younger brother, love as did Zou Ji; tears brim to the lashes. I still raise my hand and turn away, ashamed to act like a woman.
translations.idiomatic: You, my younger friend, love as Zou Ji did, with tears brimming to your lashes. I still raise my hand and turn away, ashamed to behave like a woman.

sentences.zh: 素鐘肇節，金飆戒序，起居無恙，動靜履宜。

translations.literal: The white bell marks the beginning of the season; the golden blast warns of the sequence. May your rising and resting be without ailment, and your movements and stillness keep to what is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The white bell marks the season's beginning, and the golden wind warns that the year is turning. May your daily life be free of illness, and may your comings and goings keep to what is proper.

sentences.zh: 子雲筆札，元瑜書記，信用旣然，可樂爲甚。

translations.literal: Ziyun's letters and Yuanqu's records—since trust is already established, how very delightful that would be.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyun's letters and Yuanqu's records—since trust between us is already established, how welcome they would be.

sentences.zh: 且使目明，能祛首疾。

translations.literal: They would moreover brighten the eyes and could dispel the ailment of the head.
translations.idiomatic: They would brighten the eyes and could even relieve the pain in one's head.

sentences.zh: 甚善甚善。

translations.literal: Very good, very good.
translations.idiomatic: Excellent, excellent.

sentences.zh: 吾無昔人之才而有其病，癲眩屢動，消渴頻增。

translations.literal: I lack the talent of the men of old but have their ailments; dizzy fits strike repeatedly and thirsting consumption grows ever more frequent.
translations.idiomatic: I lack the talent of the men of old but share their infirmities: dizzy spells strike again and again, and my wasting thirst grows ever worse.

sentences.zh: 委化任期，故不復呼醫飲藥。

translations.literal: I entrust transformation to allotted fate and therefore no longer summon physicians or take medicine.
translations.idiomatic: I leave transformation to fate and no longer call for physicians or take medicine.

sentences.zh: 但恨一旦離大辱，蹈明科，去皎皎而非自汙，抱鬱結而無誰告。

translations.literal: I only regret that in a single day I left great disgrace, trod the clear statute, departed brightness though I did not stain myself, and embrace knotted grief with no one to whom I may tell it.
translations.idiomatic: I only regret that in a single day I fell from great honor into clear statute, left the bright path though I did not stain myself, and now hold knotted grief with no one to whom I can tell it.

sentences.zh: 丁年蓄積，與此銷亡，徒竊高價厚名，橫叨公器人爵，智能無所報，筋力未之酬，所以悲至撫膺，泣盡而繼之以血。

translations.literal: The store of my prime years is consumed with this; I have only stolen a high price and thick name and presumptuously received public vessels and human ranks. My intelligence has nowhere to repay, my sinew and strength have not been recompensed; therefore grief reaches the point of clutching my breast, tears are exhausted and blood follows.
translations.idiomatic: The store of my prime years has vanished with this. I have only stolen a lofty reputation and thick renown and presumptuously received public office and human rank. My intelligence has had nowhere to repay your grace, and my strength has had no chance to requite it. That is why grief drives me to clutch my breast, until tears are exhausted and blood follows.

sentences.zh: 顧惟不肖，文質無所底，蓋困於衣食，迫於饑寒，依隱易農，所志不過鐘庾。

translations.literal: Looking back on my lack of talent, I have no foundation in culture or substance; I was trapped by food and clothing, pressed by hunger and cold, leaning on seclusion and changing to farming—my ambition went no farther than a granary measure.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back on my lack of talent, I had no foundation in learning or substance. I was trapped by food and clothing and pressed by hunger and cold, leaning on seclusion and turning to farming; my ambition went no farther than filling a granary measure.

sentences.zh: 久爲尺板鬥食之吏，以從皁衣黑綬之役，非有奇才絕學，雄略高謨，吐一言可以匡俗振民，動一議可以固邦興國。

translations.literal: For long I was an official of the foot-rule tablet and peck of grain, following service in black robes with black ribbons; I had no wondrous talent or supreme learning, no heroic strategy or lofty design, no word that on being spoken could correct custom and revive the people, no proposal that on being moved could secure the state and raise the realm.
translations.idiomatic: For years I was a petty clerk living on a peck of grain, serving in black robes with black ribbons. I had no wondrous talent or supreme learning, no heroic strategy or lofty design, no word that could correct custom and revive the people, no proposal that could secure the state and raise the realm.

sentences.zh: 全璧歸趙，飛矢救燕，偃息籓魏，甘臥安郢，腦日逐，髓月支，擁十萬而橫行，提五千而深入，將能執圭裂壤，功勒景鐘，錦繡爲衣，朱丹被轂，斯大丈夫之志，非吾曹之所能及已。

translations.literal: To return the whole jade to Zhao, to shoot the flying arrow to save Yan, to lie at ease in the fiefs of Wei, to sleep content in the peace of Ying, to give one's brains to the Rong of Riyue and one's marrow to the Yuezhi, to lead a hundred thousand in unchecked advance or five thousand in deep penetration, to be able to hold the jade tablet and split the soil, to inscribe merit on the Bell of Splendor, to wear brocade as garments and cinnabar on the wheel hubs—that is the ambition of a great man, not what men like us can reach.
translations.idiomatic: To return the jade intact to Zhao, to shoot the flying arrow that saves Yan, to rest at ease in the fiefs of Wei, to sleep content in the peace of Ying, to give one's brains to the Rong of Riyue and one's marrow to the Yuezhi, to lead a hundred thousand in unchecked advance or five thousand in a deep strike, to hold the jade tablet and carve up the realm, to inscribe one's merit on the Bell of Splendor, to wear brocade and paint one's wheel hubs cinnabar red—that is the ambition of a true hero, not something men like us can attain.

sentences.zh: 直以章句小才，蟲篆末藝，含吐緗縹之上，翩躚樽俎之側，委曲同之針縷，繁碎譬之米鹽，孰致顯榮，何能至到。

translations.literal: I have only the small talent of exegetical clauses and the lowest art of insect seal script—uttering words above silk bindings, fluttering beside wine and meat, intricate as needlework, trivial as rice and salt; who could thereby win manifest glory, how could one arrive?
translations.idiomatic: I had only the petty talent of exegetical glosses and the lowest skill of seal script—speaking above silk-bound books, fluttering beside wine and meat, intricate as needlework, trivial as rice and salt. Who could win manifest glory by such means, and how could one reach the heights?

sentences.zh: 加性疏澀，拙於進取，未嘗去來許、史，遨遊梁、竇，俯首脅肩，先意承旨。

translations.literal: Moreover my nature is blunt and obstructed and clumsy at advancement; I have never gone back and forth to the houses of Xu and Shi or roamed with Liang and Dou, bowing my head and hunching my shoulders to anticipate intent and carry out orders.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover my nature is blunt and awkward at advancement. I never paid court to the houses of Xu and Shi or kept company with Liang Ji and Dou Xian, bowing my head and hunching my shoulders to anticipate their wishes.

sentences.zh: 是以三葉靡遘，不與運幷，十年未徙，孰非能薄。

translations.literal: Therefore for three generations I met no encounter and did not rise with the age; ten years without transfer—who would say it was not thin ability?
translations.idiomatic: That is why for three generations I met no opportunity and did not rise with the times; ten years passed without promotion—who could say my ability was not slight?

sentences.zh: 及除舊佈新，清晷方旦，抱樂銜圖，訟謳有主，而猶限一吏于岑石，隔千里於泉亭，不得奉板中涓，預衣裳之會，提戈後勁，厠龍豹之謀。

translations.literal: When the old was removed and the new spread, when the clear gnomon stood at dawn, men embraced music and held charts and songs of praise had their lord—yet I was still confined as a single clerk at Censhi, separated by a thousand li at Quan Pavilion, unable to present the board as palace attendant, to take part in the robe-and-cap assembly, to bear spear as rear striking force, or to join the counsels of dragon and leopard.
translations.idiomatic: When the old order was swept away and the new spread forth, when the clear dawn had broken and men embraced music and held the charts, when songs of praise had found their lord—I was still confined as a petty clerk at Censhi, separated by a thousand li at Quan Pavilion, unable to present the memorial board as palace attendant, to take part in the robe-and-cap assembly, to bear spear as rear striking force, or to join the counsels of dragon and leopard.

sentences.zh: 及其投劾歸來，恩均舊隸，升文石，登玉陛，一見而降顏色，再睹而接話言，非藉左右之容，無勞羣公之助。

translations.literal: When I submitted my resignation and returned, favor was equal to that of old retainers; I ascended the patterned stone and climbed the jade steps—on one meeting your countenance softened, on a second you received my words, without borrowing the looks of attendants at your side or the help of the assembled lords.
translations.idiomatic: When I submitted my resignation and returned, your favor matched that shown old retainers. I ascended the patterned stone and climbed the jade steps; on one meeting your countenance softened, on a second you received my words—without relying on attendants at your side or the help of the assembled lords.

sentences.zh: 又非同席共研之夙逢，笥餌卮酒之早識，一旦陪武帳，仰文陛，備聃、佚之柱下，充嚴、朱之席上，入班九棘，出專千里，據操撮之雄官，參人倫之顯職，雖古之爵人不次，取士無名，未有躡影追風，奔驟之若此者也。

translations.literal: Nor was it like an old meeting of shared mat and joint study, or an early acquaintance over basket delicacies and cup wine; in a single day I attended the martial canopy and looked up at the patterned steps, stood ready like Laozi and Zhuangzi below the pillar, filled a place on the mat with Yan and Zhu, entered the ranks of the nine thorns, went out to monopolize a thousand li, held a heroic office that grasped the balance, and took part in the manifest duties of human relations. Though in antiquity men were ennobled out of order and scholars taken without renown, never was there a rush like treading shadow and chasing wind.
translations.idiomatic: Nor was it like an old friendship of shared mat and joint study, or an early acquaintance over basket delicacies and cup wine. In a single day I attended the martial canopy and looked up at the patterned steps, stood ready like Laozi and Zhuangzi below the pillar, took a place on the mat with Yan Guang and Zhu Yun, entered the ranks of the nine thorns, went out to govern a thousand li, held a heroic office that grasped the balance, and took part in the manifest duties of human relations. Though in antiquity men were ennobled out of order and scholars taken without renown, never was there a rush like treading shadow and chasing wind.

sentences.zh: 蓋基薄牆高，途遙力躓，傾蹶必然，顛匐可俟。

translations.literal: The foundation was thin and the wall high, the road long and strength faltering—collapse was inevitable, a fall could be awaited.
translations.idiomatic: The foundation was thin and the wall high, the road long and my strength faltering—collapse was inevitable, and a fall could be foreseen.

sentences.zh: 竟以福過災生，人指鬼瞰，將均宥器，有驗傾卮，是以不能早從曲影，遂乃取疑邪徑。

translations.literal: In the end, because blessing passed its measure disaster arose; men pointed and ghosts glared down; the leveling of the pardoning vessel had proof in the overturned cup—therefore I could not early follow the bent shadow and so took a doubtful, crooked path.
translations.idiomatic: In the end, because blessing had exceeded its measure, disaster arose. Men pointed at me and ghosts glared down. The leveling of the pardoning vessel was proved by the overturned cup. That is why I could not early follow the bent shadow and so took a doubtful, crooked path.

sentences.zh: 故司隸懍懍，思得應弦，譬縣廚之獸，如離繳之鳥，將充庖鼎，以餌鷹鸇。

translations.literal: Therefore the Metropolitan Commandant was stern and severe, thinking to catch me as the arrow answers the string—like a beast hung in the kitchen or a bird that has left the bowstring, about to fill the cauldron and pot and become bait for hawk and kite.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Metropolitan Commandant was stern and severe, eager to catch me as an arrow answers the string—like a beast hung in the kitchen or a bird that has left the bowstring, about to fill the cauldron and become bait for hawk and kite.

sentences.zh: 雖事異鑽皮，文非刺骨，猶復因茲舌杪，成此筆端，上可以投畀北方，次可以論輸左校，變爲丹赭，充彼舂薪。

translations.literal: Though the matter differed from boring through hide and the text was not bone-piercing, still through the tip of the tongue it became this at the brush's end: at the highest level I could be cast out to the north; next I could be sentenced and sent to the Left School; changed to cinnabar ochre, I would fill their pounding firewood.
translations.idiomatic: Though the matter differed from boring through hide and the text was not bone-piercing, still through the tip of the tongue it became this at the brush's end: at worst I could be cast out to the north; next I could be sentenced and sent to the Left School; turned cinnabar red, I would fill their pounding firewood.

sentences.zh: 幸聖主留善貸之德，紆好生之施，解網祝禽，下車泣罪，愍茲■詬，憐其觳觫，加肉朽胔，布葉枯株，輟薪止火，得不銷爛。

translations.literal: Fortunately the sage lord retained the virtue of granting good pardons and extended the favor of cherishing life: he released the net and prayed over the bird, descended from the carriage and wept over guilt, pitied this abuse and favored my trembling fright, added flesh to rotting carcass and spread leaves on withered stump, stopped the firewood and halted the fire, so that I was not consumed to ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately the sage lord retained the virtue of granting good pardons and extended the favor of cherishing life: he released the net and prayed over the bird, descended from his carriage and wept over guilt, pitied this abuse and favored my trembling fright, added flesh to a rotting carcass and spread leaves on a withered stump, stopped the firewood and halted the fire, so that I was not consumed to ruin.

sentences.zh: 所謂還魂鬥極，追氣泰山，止復除名爲民，幅巾家巷，此五十年之後，人君之賜焉。

translations.literal: This is what is called returning the soul at the Dipper's pole and pursuing breath to Mount Tai; I was only removed from the register and made a commoner, wearing plain cloth in home lanes—this, after fifty years, is the ruler's gift.
translations.idiomatic: This is what is called returning the soul at the Dipper's pole and pursuing breath to Mount Tai: I was only struck from the register and made a commoner, wearing plain cloth in the lanes of home—that, after fifty years, is the ruler's gift.

sentences.zh: 木石感陰陽，犬馬識厚薄，員首方足，孰不戴天？

translations.literal: Wood and stone respond to yin and yang; dogs and horses know thick and thin; round head and square foot—who does not bear Heaven on his head?
translations.idiomatic: Wood and stone respond to yin and yang; dogs and horses know gratitude and neglect; every living being with round head and square foot—who does not bear Heaven on his head?

sentences.zh: 而竊自有悲者，蓋士無賢不肖，在朝見嫉；

translations.literal: Yet I privately have my own grief: generally whether a gentleman is worthy or unworthy, once in court he meets jealousy;
translations.idiomatic: Yet I privately grieve over this: whether a gentleman is worthy or not, once he enters court he meets jealousy;

sentences.zh: 女無美惡，入宮見妬。

translations.literal: whether a woman is beautiful or ugly, once she enters the palace she meets envy.
translations.idiomatic: whether a woman is fair or plain, once she enters the palace she meets envy.

sentences.zh: 家貧，無苞苴可以事朋類，惡其鄉原，恥彼戚施，何以從人，何以徇物？

translations.literal: My family is poor and I have no gifts in bundles to serve my circle of friends; I detest those smooth village worthies and am ashamed of those bent-backed flatterers—how could I follow others, how could I court things?
translations.idiomatic: My family is poor and I have no gifts with which to court my circle of friends. I detest those smooth village worthies and am ashamed of those hunchbacked flatterers—how could I follow others, how could I court the world?

sentences.zh: 外無奔走之友，內乏強近之親。

translations.literal: Outside I have no friends who run errands for me; inside I lack powerful near kin.
translations.idiomatic: Outside I have no friends to run errands for me; within I lack powerful relatives close at hand.

sentences.zh: 是以構市之徒，隨相媒糵。

translations.literal: Therefore the men who frame markets follow one another in brewing malice.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the men who trade in slander follow one another in brewing malice.

sentences.zh: 及一朝捐棄，以快怨者之心，吁可悲矣。

translations.literal: When in a single morning I was cast aside to satisfy the hearts of those who bore resentment—ah, how lamentable!
translations.idiomatic: When in a single morning I was cast aside to satisfy those who bore resentment—ah, how lamentable!

sentences.zh: 蓋先貴後賤，古富今貧，季倫所以發此哀音，雍門所以和其悲曲。

translations.literal: It is that one is first noble and later base, anciently rich and now poor—this is why Jilun uttered this mournful tone and why Yongmen harmonized this sorrowful tune.
translations.idiomatic: It is that one is first honored and later humbled, once rich and now poor—this is why Shi Jilun uttered this mournful tone and why Yongmen harmonized this sorrowful tune.

sentences.zh: 又迫以嚴秋殺氣，具物多悲，長夜輾轉，百憂俱至。

translations.literal: Moreover I am pressed by the stern autumn's killing breath; all things are full of sorrow. Through the long night I toss and turn, and a hundred griefs arrive together.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover I am pressed by the stern breath of autumn, when all things are full of sorrow. Through the long night I toss and turn as a hundred griefs arrive together.

sentences.zh: 況復霜銷草色，風搖樹影。

translations.literal: How much more when frost wears away the color of the grass and wind shakes the shadows of the trees.
translations.idiomatic: How much more when frost wears away the green of the grass and wind shakes the shadows of the trees.

sentences.zh: 寒蟲夕叫，合輕重而同悲；

translations.literal: Cold insects cry at evening, joining light and heavy in the same grief;
translations.idiomatic: Cold insects cry at evening, joining great and small in the same grief;

sentences.zh: 秋葉晚傷，雜黃紫而俱墜。

translations.literal: autumn leaves wounded late, mingling yellow and purple as they all fall.
translations.idiomatic: autumn leaves wounded late in the year, mingling yellow and purple as they all fall.

sentences.zh: 蜘蛛絡幕，熠耀爭飛，故無車轍馬聲，何聞鳴雞吠犬。

translations.literal: Spiders web the curtain; fireflies vie in flight—therefore no sound of carriage tracks or horses; how could one hear crowing cocks or barking dogs?
translations.idiomatic: Spiders web the curtain; fireflies dart and vie in flight—so there is no sound of carriage tracks or horses, and how could one hear crowing cocks or barking dogs?

sentences.zh: 俯眉事妻子，舉手謝賓遊。

translations.literal: I lower my brows to serve wife and children and raise my hand to bid farewell to wandering guests.
translations.idiomatic: I lower my brows to serve wife and children and raise my hand to bid farewell to visiting friends.

sentences.zh: 方與飛走爲鄰，永用蓬蒿自沒。

translations.literal: I am just now neighbor to things that fly and run and shall forever bury myself in mugwort and artemisia.
translations.idiomatic: I am about to make my neighbors of things that fly and run and shall forever bury myself in the wild weeds.

sentences.zh: 愾其長息，忽不覺生之爲重。

translations.literal: Sighing with long breaths, I suddenly do not feel that life is weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Sighing with long breaths, I suddenly no longer feel that life is weighty.

sentences.zh: 素無一廛之田，而有數口之累。

translations.literal: I have never had a single homestead's field, yet I bear the burden of several mouths.
translations.idiomatic: I have never had even a single homestead's field, yet I bear the burden of several mouths to feed.

sentences.zh: 豈曰匏而不食，方當長爲傭保，糊口寄身，溘死溝渠，以實螻蟻。

translations.literal: Can one say I am a gourd that does not eat? I am about to become a hired laborer for long, patching my mouth with food and lodging my body—suddenly dying in ditch and channel to fill the ants.
translations.idiomatic: Can one say I am a gourd that does not eat? I am about to spend my life as a hired hand, earning my mouthful where I can and lodging where I may—dying suddenly in ditch and channel to feed the ants.

sentences.zh: 悲夫！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 豈復得與二三士友，抱接膝之歡，履足差肩，摛綺縠之清文，談希微之道德。

translations.literal: How could I again share with two or three scholar friends the joy of knees touching in embrace, feet matching and shoulders abreast, composing pure writings in brocade and gauze, and discoursing on the subtle Way?
translations.idiomatic: How could I again share with two or three scholar friends the joy of knees touching in embrace, walking shoulder to shoulder, composing pure writings in brocade and gauze, and discoursing on the subtle Way?

sentences.zh: 唯吳馮之遇夏馥，范式之值孔嵩，愍其留賃，憐此行乞耳。

translations.literal: Only as Wu Feng met Xia Fu or Fan Shi encountered Kong Song—pitying my retained lodging and favoring this beggar on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Only as Wu Feng met Xia Fu or Fan Shi encountered Kong Song—pitying my retained lodging and favoring this beggar on the road.

sentences.zh: 儻不以垢累，時存寸札，則雖先犬馬，猶松喬焉。

translations.literal: If you are not burdened by my filth and occasionally keep a brief note, then though I go before dogs and horses I would still be like Song and Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: If you are not burdened by my disgrace and occasionally send a brief note, then though I go before dogs and horses I would still be like the immortals Song and Qiao.

sentences.zh: 去矣何生，高樹芳烈。

translations.literal: I go—what life remains? Raise high your fragrant virtue.
translations.idiomatic: I go—what life remains? Raise high your fragrant virtue.

sentences.zh: 裁書代面，筆淚俱下。

translations.literal: I cut this letter to stand for my face; brush and tears fall together.
translations.idiomatic: I cut this letter to stand for my face; brush and tears fall together.

sentences.zh: 久之，起爲安西安成王參軍，累遷鎮右始興王中記室，北中郎南康王諮議參軍，入直西省，知撰譜事。

translations.literal: After a long time he was raised as Adjutant to Anxi, Prince of Ancheng, and by successive transfers became Middle Recorder on the staff of Zhenyou, Prince of Shixing, Consultant on the staff of the Northern Commandant and Prince of Nankang, entered service on duty in the Western Office, and was put in charge of compiling genealogies.
translations.idiomatic: After a long interval he was recalled as adjutant to Anxi, Prince of Ancheng, and was successively promoted to middle recorder on the staff of Zhenyou, Prince of Shixing, consultant on the staff of the Northern Commandant and Prince of Nankang, entered duty in the Western Office, and was placed in charge of compiling genealogies.

sentences.zh: 普通三年，卒，時年五十八。

translations.literal: In the third year of Putong he died, at the age of fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Putong era he died, at the age of fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 僧孺好墳籍，聚書至萬餘卷，率多異本，與沈約、任昉家書相埒。

translations.literal: Sengru loved ancient texts and collected books to more than ten thousand scrolls, mostly rare editions, rivaling the family libraries of Shen Yue and Ren Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru loved ancient texts and amassed more than ten thousand scrolls, mostly rare editions, rivaling the family libraries of Shen Yue and Ren Fang.

sentences.zh: 少篤志精力，於書無所不睹。

translations.literal: From youth he was devoted in will and energy and in books there was nothing he did not read.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was devoted in will and energy, and there was no book he did not read.

sentences.zh: 其文麗逸，多用新事，人所未見者，世重其富。

translations.literal: His writings were beautiful and elegant, often using new allusions that others had not seen; the age prized their richness.
translations.idiomatic: His writings were beautiful and elegant, often drawing on fresh allusions others had not seen, and the age prized their richness.

sentences.zh: 僧孺集《十八州譜》七百一十卷，《百家譜集》十五卷，《東南譜集抄》十卷，文集三十卷，《兩臺彈事》不入集內爲五卷，及《東宮新記》，並行於世。

translations.literal: Sengru compiled the Genealogies of the Eighteen Provinces in 710 scrolls, the Collected Genealogies of the Hundred Clans in 15 scrolls, the Extracted Genealogies of the Southeast in 10 scrolls, a literary collection in 30 scrolls, the Memorials of the Two Offices in 5 scrolls not included in the collection, and the New Records of the Eastern Palace—all circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru compiled the Genealogies of the Eighteen Provinces in seven hundred ten scrolls, the Collected Genealogies of the Hundred Clans in fifteen scrolls, the Extracted Genealogies of the Southeast in ten scrolls, a literary collection in thirty scrolls, the Memorials of the Two Offices in five scrolls not included in the collection, and the New Records of the Eastern Palace—all of which circulated in his day.

sentences.zh: 張率字士簡，吳郡吳人。

translations.literal: Zhang Shuai, styled Shijian, was a native of Wu in Wu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shuai, whose courtesy name was Shijian, came from Wu in Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 祖永，宋右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yong was Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness of Song.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yong had served the Song as Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 父瑰，齊世顯貴，歸老鄉邑，天監初，授右光祿，加給事中。

translations.literal: His father Gui was eminent and honored under Qi, retired to old age in his home district, and at the beginning of Tianjian was appointed Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the additional title of Attendant Within the Yellow Gates.
translations.idiomatic: His father Gui had been eminent under the Qi, retired to his home district in old age, and at the beginning of the Tianjian reign was appointed Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the additional title of Attendant Within the Yellow Gates.

sentences.zh: 率年十二，能屬文，常日限爲詩一篇，稍進作賦頌，至年十六，向二千許首。

translations.literal: At twelve Shuai could compose literary pieces, regularly setting himself a daily quota of one poem; gradually he advanced to composing fu and eulogies, and by sixteen had turned out nearly two thousand pieces.
translations.idiomatic: At twelve Shuai could compose literary pieces and regularly set himself a daily quota of one poem. Gradually he advanced to fu and eulogies, and by sixteen had produced nearly two thousand pieces.

sentences.zh: 齊始安王蕭遙光爲揚州，召迎主簿，不就。

translations.literal: When Xiao Yao Guang, Prince of Shi'an of Qi, was in Yangzhou he summoned him as Reception Chief Clerk, but Shuai did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiao Yao Guang, Prince of Shi'an of Qi, held Yangzhou, he summoned Shuai as reception chief clerk, but Shuai declined.

sentences.zh: 起家著作佐郎。

translations.literal: He began his career as Assistant Gentleman of the Composition Office.
translations.idiomatic: He began his career as Assistant Gentleman of the Composition Office.

sentences.zh: 建武三年，舉秀才，除太子舍人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianwu he was recommended as a Cultivated Talent and appointed Crown Prince Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Jianwu reign he was recommended as a Cultivated Talent and appointed Crown Prince Attendant.

sentences.zh: 與同郡陸倕幼相友狎，常同載詣左衛將軍沈約，適值任昉在焉，約乃謂昉曰：「此二子後進才秀，皆南金也，卿可與定交。

translations.literal: With Lu Yan of the same commandery he had been intimate friends from youth; they often rode together to visit Shen Yue, General of the Left Guard, and happened to find Ren Fang there. Yue then said to Fang, "These two youths are talented newcomers, both southern gold—you may form friendship with them."
translations.idiomatic: With Lu Yan of the same commandery he had been close friends from childhood. They often rode together to visit Shen Yue, General of the Left Guard, and happened to find Ren Fang there. Yue said to Fang, "These two young men are talented newcomers, both southern gold—you should befriend them."

sentences.zh: 」由此與昉友善。

translations.literal: " From this he became friendly with Fang.
translations.idiomatic: " From this he became friends with Fang.

sentences.zh: 遷尚書殿中郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Palace Gentleman of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Palace Gentleman of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 出爲西中郎南康王功曹史，以疾不就。

translations.literal: He went out as Merit Officer Secretary to the Western Commandant and Prince of Nankang but did not take up the post because of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as merit officer secretary to the Western Commandant and Prince of Nankang but did not take up the post because of illness.

sentences.zh: 久之，除太子洗馬。

translations.literal: After a long time he was appointed Crown Prince Groom.
translations.idiomatic: After a long interval he was appointed Crown Prince Groom.

sentences.zh: 高祖霸府建，引爲相國主簿。

translations.literal: When the High Ancestor established his hegemon's office, Shuai was brought in as Chief Clerk to the Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu established his hegemon's office, Shuai was brought in as chief clerk to the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 天監初，臨川王已下並置友、學。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian the Prince of Linchuan and those below him were all given Friends and Scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianjian reign the Prince of Linchuan and the other princes were all given literary friends and scholars.

sentences.zh: 以率爲鄱陽王友，遷司徒謝朏掾，直文德待詔省。

translations.literal: Shuai was made Friend to the Prince of Poyang, transferred to be Aide to Xie Tiao, Minister over the Masses, and served on duty in the Wende Office awaiting edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Shuai was made literary friend to the Prince of Poyang, transferred to be aide to Xie Tiao, Minister over the Masses, and served on duty in the Wende Office awaiting edicts.

sentences.zh: 敕使抄乙部書，又使撰婦人事二十餘條，勒成百卷。

translations.literal: He was ordered to copy books of the second category and also to compile more than twenty items on women's affairs, which were edited into a hundred scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to copy books of the second category and also to compile more than twenty items on women's affairs, which were edited into a hundred scrolls.

sentences.zh: 使工書人琅邪王深、吳郡范懷約、褚洵等繕寫，以給後宮。

translations.literal: He had skilled calligraphers Wang Shen of Langye, Fan Huaiyue of Wu commandery, Chu Xun, and others copy them out to supply the rear palace.
translations.idiomatic: He had skilled calligraphers Wang Shen of Langye, Fan Huaiyue of Wu commandery, Chu Xun, and others copy them out for the rear palace.

sentences.zh: 率又爲《待詔賦》奏之，甚見稱賞。

translations.literal: Shuai also composed a Fu on Awaiting Edicts and presented it; he was greatly praised and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Shuai also composed a "Fu on Awaiting Edicts" and presented it; he was greatly praised and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 手敕答曰：「省賦殊佳。

translations.literal: An imperial autograph reply said, "I have reviewed the fu and it is exceptionally fine."
translations.idiomatic: An imperial autograph reply said, "I have reviewed the fu and it is exceptionally fine."

sentences.zh: 相如工而不敏，枚皋速而不工，卿可謂兼二子于金馬矣。

translations.literal: Xiangru was skilled but not quick; Meigao was quick but not skilled—you may be said to combine the two men at the Golden Horse Gate."
translations.idiomatic: Sima Xiangru was skilled but not quick; Mei Gao was quick but not skilled—you may be said to combine the two men at the Golden Horse Gate."

sentences.zh: 」又侍宴賦詩，高祖乃別賜率詩曰：「東南有才子，故能服官政。

translations.literal: " At another banquet he composed poetry in attendance, and the High Ancestor separately bestowed a poem on Shuai that reads: "In the southeast there is a talented man, and therefore he can attend to official government."
translations.idiomatic: " At another banquet he composed poetry in attendance, and Emperor Wu separately bestowed a poem on Shuai that reads: "In the southeast there is a talented man, and therefore he can attend to official government."

sentences.zh: 余雖慚古昔，得人今爲盛。

translations.literal: Though I am ashamed before antiquity, in gaining men the present is flourishing."
translations.idiomatic: Though I am ashamed before antiquity, in gaining men the present is flourishing."

sentences.zh: 」率奉詔往返數首。

translations.literal: " Shuai received the edict and returned several pieces in reply.
translations.idiomatic: " Shuai received the edict and returned several poems in reply.

sentences.zh: 其年，遷秘書丞，引見玉衡殿。

translations.literal: That year he was transferred to Secretariat Aide and summoned to audience in Yuhéng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was promoted to Secretariat Aide and summoned to audience in Yuhéng Hall.

sentences.zh: 高祖曰：「秘書丞天下清官，東南胄望未有爲之者，今以相處，足爲卿譽。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor said, "The Secretariat Aide is the purest office under Heaven; no eminent southeastern house had yet held it. Now in placing you there, it is enough for your reputation."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu said, "The Secretariat Aide is the purest office under Heaven; no eminent southeastern house had yet held it. Now in placing you there, it is enough for your reputation."

sentences.zh: 」其恩遇如此。

translations.literal: " His favor and treatment were like this.
translations.idiomatic: " Such was the favor shown him.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，禊飲華光殿。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year there was a purification feast in Huaguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year there was a purification feast in Huaguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 其日，河南國獻舞馬，詔率賦之，曰：

translations.literal: On that day the state of Henan presented dancing horses, and an edict ordered Shuai to compose a fu on them. It begins:
translations.idiomatic: On that day the state of Henan presented dancing horses, and an edict ordered Shuai to compose a fu on them. It begins:

sentences.zh: 臣聞「天用莫如龍，地用莫如馬。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard, "For Heaven's use nothing is like the dragon; for Earth's use nothing is like the horse."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has heard, "For Heaven's use nothing is like the dragon; for Earth's use nothing is like the horse."

sentences.zh: 」故《禮》稱驪騵，《詩》誦騮駱。

translations.literal: " Therefore the Rites speak of black and piebald horses, and the Odes chant bay and white-limbed steeds.
translations.idiomatic: " Therefore the Rites speak of black and piebald horses, and the Odes chant bay and white-limbed steeds.

sentences.zh: 先景遺風之美，世所得聞；

translations.literal: The beauty of the legacy wind of former splendor is what the age has been able to hear;
translations.idiomatic: The beauty of the legacy left by former splendor is what the age has been able to hear;

sentences.zh: 吐圖騰光之異，有時而出。

translations.literal: the marvel of spitting forth charts and soaring light appears only at certain times.
translations.idiomatic: the marvel of spitting forth charts and soaring light appears only at certain times.

sentences.zh: 洎我大梁，光有區夏，廣運自中，員照無外，日入之所，浮琛委贄，風被之域，越險效珍，軨服烏號之駿，騊駼豢龍之名。

translations.literal: Down to our Great Liang, its radiance covers the central realm; its broad movement proceeds from the center and its full illumination has nothing outside it. Where the sun sets, floating jade and piled tribute arrive; where the wind reaches, men cross peril to offer treasures. Carriages are harnessed to the swiftness of Wuhào and the fame of Taotu and dragon-rearing is practiced.
translations.idiomatic: Down to our Great Liang, whose radiance covers the central realm, whose broad movement proceeds from the center and whose full illumination leaves nothing outside it: where the sun sets, floating jade and piled tribute arrive; where the wind reaches, men cross peril to offer treasures. Carriages are harnessed to the swiftness of Wuhào, and the fame of Taotu and dragon-rearing is practiced.

sentences.zh: 而河南又獻赤龍駒，有奇貌絕足，能拜善舞。

translations.literal: Moreover Henan again presented a crimson dragon colt with a strange appearance and surpassing hooves, able to bow and skilled at dancing.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Henan again presented a crimson dragon colt with a strange appearance and surpassing hooves, able to bow and skilled at dancing.

sentences.zh: 天子異之，使臣作賦，曰：

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven marveled at it and had your servant compose a fu, which says:
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven marveled at it and had your servant compose a fu, which says:

sentences.zh: 維梁受命四載，元符旣臻，協律之事具舉，膠庠之教必陳，檀輿之用已偃，玉輅之御方巡。

translations.literal: It is now the fourth year since Liang received the Mandate; the primordial talisman has already arrived. Affairs of harmonizing the pitch pipes are fully undertaken, the instruction of the glued school must be displayed, the use of the sandalwood carriage has already ceased, and the jade chariot's progress is just setting out on tour.
translations.idiomatic: It is now the fourth year since Liang received the Mandate; the primordial talisman has already arrived. Affairs of harmonizing the pitch pipes are fully undertaken, the instruction of the glued school must be displayed, the use of the sandalwood carriage has already ceased, and the jade chariot's progress is just setting out on tour.

sentences.zh: 考帝文而率通，披皇圖以大觀。

translations.literal: Examining the emperor's writings and leading through them, he spreads the imperial charts for a great survey.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the emperor's writings and leading through them, he spreads the imperial charts for a great survey.

sentences.zh: 慶惟道而必先，靈匪聖其誰贊。

translations.literal: Rejoicing in the Way and putting it first, the numinous—if not the sage, who could praise it?
translations.idiomatic: Rejoicing in the Way and putting it first—the numinous: if not the sage, who could praise it?

sentences.zh: 見河龍之瑞唐，矚天馬之禎漢。

translations.literal: He sees the river dragon's omen in Tang and gazes on the heavenly horse's auspice in Han.
translations.idiomatic: He sees the river dragon's omen in Tang and gazes on the heavenly horse's auspice in Han.

sentences.zh: 旣叶符而比德，且同條而共貫。

translations.literal: Already matching the talisman and comparing in virtue, moreover sharing the same strand and running through together.
translations.idiomatic: Already matching the talisman and comparing in virtue, moreover sharing the same strand and running through together.

sentences.zh: 詢國美於斯今，邁皇王於曩昔。

translations.literal: Inquiring into the state's beauty in this present age, it surpasses the imperial kings of former times.
translations.idiomatic: Inquiring into the state's beauty in this present age, it surpasses the imperial kings of former times.

sentences.zh: 散大明以燭幽，揚義聲而遠斥。

translations.literal: It spreads great brightness to illumine the dark and raises the voice of righteousness to drive off the distant.
translations.idiomatic: It spreads great brightness to illumine the dark and raises the voice of righteousness to drive off the distant.

sentences.zh: 固施之於不窮，諒無所乎朝夕。

translations.literal: Firmly applied without end, surely it has no limit in morning or evening.
translations.idiomatic: Firmly applied without end, surely it has no limit in morning or evening.

sentences.zh: 並承流以請吏，咸向風而率職。

translations.literal: All receive the current and request officials; all turn to the wind and lead their duties.
translations.idiomatic: All receive the current and request officials; all turn to the wind and lead their duties.

sentences.zh: 納奇貢於絕區，致龍媒於殊域。

translations.literal: They bring in strange tribute from the farthest regions and present dragon steeds from exotic lands.
translations.idiomatic: They bring in strange tribute from the farthest regions and present dragon steeds from exotic lands.

sentences.zh: 伊況古而赤文，爰在茲而硃翼。

translations.literal: This one resembles antiquity in its crimson markings and is here now with vermilion wings.
translations.idiomatic: This one resembles antiquity in its crimson markings and is here now with vermilion wings.

sentences.zh: 旣效德於炎運，亦表祥於尚色。

translations.literal: It has already shown virtue in the fiery age and also displayed auspice in the honored color.
translations.idiomatic: It has already shown virtue in the fiery age and also displayed auspice in the honored color.

sentences.zh: 資皎月而載生，祖河房而挺授。

translations.literal: Drawing on the bright moon for its birth, it takes the River House as ancestor and stands upright in bestowal.
translations.idiomatic: Drawing on the bright moon for its birth, it takes the River House as ancestor and stands upright in bestowal.

sentences.zh: 種北唐之絕類，嗣西宛之鴻胄。

translations.literal: It is the unique kind of North Tang and heir to the great bloodline of Western Wan.
translations.idiomatic: It is the unique kind of North Tang and heir to the great bloodline of Western Wan.

sentences.zh: 稟妙足而逸倫，有殊姿而特茂。

translations.literal: Endowed with marvelous hooves and transcending its kind, it has a special form and exceptional vigor.
translations.idiomatic: Endowed with marvelous hooves and transcending its kind, it has a special form and exceptional vigor.

sentences.zh: 善環旋于薺夏，知蹈颻于金奏。

translations.literal: It is skilled at circling in the manner of Ji and Xia and knows how to tread the rhythm in golden music.
translations.idiomatic: It is skilled at circling in the manner of Ji and Xia and knows how to tread the rhythm in golden music.

sentences.zh: 超六種于周閑，逾八品於漢廄。

translations.literal: It surpasses the six kinds in the Zhou stables and exceeds the eight grades in the Han mangers.
translations.idiomatic: It surpasses the six kinds in the Zhou stables and exceeds the eight grades in the Han mangers.

sentences.zh: 伊自然之有質，寧改觀於肥瘦。

translations.literal: It has nature's substance—how could one change one's view because of fat or thin?
translations.idiomatic: It has nature's substance—how could one change one's view because of fat or thin?

sentences.zh: 豈徒服皁而養安，與進駕以馳驟。

translations.literal: How could it merely wear black and be kept at ease, rather than join the advancing carriage and gallop?
translations.idiomatic: How could it merely wear black and be kept at ease, rather than join the advancing carriage and gallop?

sentences.zh: 爾其挾尺縣鑿之辨，附蟬伏兎之別，十形五觀之姿，三毛八肉之勢，臣何得而稱焉，固已詳於前制。

translations.literal: As for its grasp of foot-rule and hanging-chisel distinctions, cicada-attachment and crouching-rabbit differences, the forms of the ten shapes and five views, and the pattern of three hairs and eight fleshes—how could your servant describe them? They are already detailed in former regulations.
translations.idiomatic: As for its grasp of foot-rule and hanging-chisel distinctions, cicada-attachment and crouching-rabbit differences, the forms of the ten shapes and five views, and the pattern of three hairs and eight fleshes—how could your servant describe them? They are already detailed in former regulations.

sentences.zh: 徒觀其神爽，視其豪異，軼跨野而忽逾輪，齊秀麒而並末駟。

translations.literal: One need only observe its spirited clarity and look on its heroic strangeness: it leaps across the wild and suddenly passes the wheel, matches the fine qilin and runs abreast with the rear team of four.
translations.idiomatic: One need only observe its spirited clarity and look on its heroic strangeness: it leaps across the wild and suddenly passes the wheel, matches the fine qilin and runs abreast with the rear team of four.

sentences.zh: 貶代盤而陋小華，越定單而少天驥。

translations.literal: It demotes Dai Pan and makes Xiaohua seem base; it surpasses Ding Dan and leaves few heavenly steeds.
translations.idiomatic: It demotes Dai Pan and makes Xiaohua seem base; it surpasses Ding Dan and leaves few heavenly steeds.

sentences.zh: 信無等於漏面，孰有取於決鼻。

translations.literal: Truly it has no equal to Loumian; who would choose Juébi?
translations.idiomatic: Truly it has no equal to Loumian; who would choose Juébi?

sentences.zh: 可以迹章、亥之所未游，逾禹、益之所未至。

translations.literal: It can tread where Zhang and Hai never traveled and go beyond where Yu and Yi never arrived.
translations.idiomatic: It can tread where Zhang and Hai never traveled and go beyond where Yu and Yi never arrived.

sentences.zh: 將不得而屈指，亦何暇以理轡。

translations.literal: One will not be able to count them on the fingers, and how would there be leisure to manage the reins?
translations.idiomatic: One will not be able to count them on the fingers, and how would there be leisure to manage the reins?

sentences.zh: 若跡遍而忘反，非我皇之所事。

translations.literal: If tracks spread everywhere and one forgets to return, that is not what our emperor undertakes.
translations.idiomatic: If tracks spread everywhere and one forgets to return, that is not what our emperor undertakes.

sentences.zh: 方潤色于前古，邈深文而儲思。

translations.literal: He is just now polishing the writings of former antiquity and storing thought in distant, profound texts.
translations.idiomatic: He is just now polishing the writings of former antiquity and storing thought in distant, profound texts.

sentences.zh: 旣而機事多暇，青春未移。

translations.literal: Then, as state affairs left much leisure, spring's green had not yet shifted.
translations.idiomatic: Then, as state affairs left much leisure, spring's green had not yet shifted.

sentences.zh: 時惟上巳，美景在斯。

translations.literal: The season was the shangsi festival; beautiful scenery was here.
translations.idiomatic: The season was the shangsi festival; beautiful scenery was here.

sentences.zh: 遵鎬飲之故實，陳洛宴之舊儀。

translations.literal: Following the old practice of the drinking at Hao, he displayed the former rites of the Luo banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Following the old practice of the drinking at Hao, he displayed the former rites of the Luo banquet.

sentences.zh: 漕伊川而分派，引激水以回池。

translations.literal: He channeled the Yi River and divided its branches, drawing rushing water to make a winding pool.
translations.idiomatic: He channeled the Yi River and divided its branches, drawing rushing water to make a winding pool.

sentences.zh: 集國良於民俊，列樹茂於皇枝。

translations.literal: He gathered the state's worthies among the people's excellence and arrayed flourishing trees along the imperial branches.
translations.idiomatic: He gathered the state's worthies among the people's excellence and arrayed flourishing trees along the imperial branches.

sentences.zh: 紛高冠以連衽，鏘鳴玉而肩隨。

translations.literal: High caps mingled with linked hems; sounding jade chimed as shoulders followed one another.
translations.idiomatic: High caps mingled with linked hems; sounding jade chimed as shoulders followed one another.

sentences.zh: 清輦道於上林，肅華臺之金座。

translations.literal: The clear carriage path led through the Upper Park; the golden seat of Splendid Terrace was made solemn.
translations.idiomatic: The clear carriage path led through the Upper Park; the golden seat of Splendid Terrace was made solemn.

sentences.zh: 望發色於綠苞，佇流芬於紫裹。

translations.literal: One looked for color breaking from green buds and waited for flowing fragrance in purple wrappings.
translations.idiomatic: One looked for color breaking from green buds and waited for flowing fragrance in purple wrappings.

sentences.zh: 聽磬寔之畢舉，聆《韶》、《夏》之咸播。

translations.literal: One listened as the stone chimes were fully raised and heard Shao and Xia played together throughout.
translations.idiomatic: One listened as the stone chimes were fully raised and heard Shao and Xia played together throughout.

sentences.zh: 承六奏之旣闋，及九變之已成。

translations.literal: Receiving the six performances already ended, and the nine variations already completed.
translations.idiomatic: When the six movements had finished and the nine variations were complete,

sentences.zh: 均儀禽於唐序，同舞獸於虞庭。

translations.literal: Equally displaying ritual birds in the hall of Tang, together dancing beasts in the court of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: they matched the ceremonial birds of the Tang hall and the beast-dances of the court of Yu.

sentences.zh: 懷夏後之九代，想陳王之紫騂。

translations.literal: Cherishing the nine generations of the Xia successor, thinking of King Chen's purple bay.
translations.idiomatic: One recalled the nine generations of the Xia kings and the purple bay steed of King Chen.

sentences.zh: 乃命涓人，效良駿，經周衛，入鉤陳。

translations.literal: Then he ordered the palace attendant, sought fine steeds, passed through Zhou and Wei, and entered Gouchen.
translations.idiomatic: Then he ordered a palace groom to fetch fine horses, passing through Zhou and Wei to bring them into the Gouchen enclosure.

sentences.zh: 言右牽之已來，寧執樸而後進。

translations.literal: Saying the right-hand groom had already come, he would rather hold the halter and follow after.
translations.idiomatic: The right-hand groom was announced as arrived, yet the horse would take the halter and advance only at its own pace.

sentences.zh: 旣傾首於律同，又蹀足於鼓振。

translations.literal: Already bowing the head at unified pitch, again pacing the hooves at the drum's vibration.
translations.idiomatic: It bowed its head in time with the unified pitch and paced its hooves to the throbbing drums.

sentences.zh: 擢龍首，回鹿軀，睨兩鏡，蹙雙鳧。

translations.literal: Raising the dragon head, turning the deer body, glancing at two mirrors, gathering the pair of mandarin ducks.
translations.idiomatic: It lifted a dragon-like head, wheeled a deer-like body, glanced sidelong as at twin mirrors, and drew its legs together like paired mandarin ducks.

sentences.zh: 旣就場而雅拜，時赴曲而徐趨。

translations.literal: Already entering the arena with an elegant bow, at times following the tune with a slow advance.
translations.idiomatic: It entered the arena with a graceful bow and, keeping to the melody, moved forward in measured steps.

sentences.zh: 敏躁中於促節，捷繁外於驚桴。

translations.literal: Agile and restless within at the quick beat, swift and complex outwardly at the startling drumstick.
translations.idiomatic: Within the rapid beats it was nimble and restless; outwardly, at each startling stroke of the drum, its movements grew swift and intricate.

sentences.zh: 騏行驥動，虎發龍驤；

translations.literal: Qilin-like in gait, Ji-horse-like in movement, tiger unleashing, dragon rearing;
translations.idiomatic: Its gait was qilin-like, its motion thoroughbred-like—tiger unleashed, dragon rearing;

sentences.zh: 雀躍燕集，鵠引鳧翔。

translations.literal: Sparrow leaping, swallow gathering, swan leading, mandarin duck flying.
translations.idiomatic: sparrow leaping, swallow alighting, swan leading, mandarin duck soaring.

sentences.zh: 妍七盤之綽約，陵九劍之抑揚。

translations.literal: Beautiful as the grace of the seven-plate dance, surpassing the rise and fall of the nine-sword dance.
translations.idiomatic: It outshone the supple grace of the seven-plate dance and surpassed the rising and falling cadences of the nine-sword dance.

sentences.zh: 豈借儀於褕袂，寧假器於髦皇。

translations.literal: How could one borrow appearance from fluttering sleeves? Rather one would borrow the implement from Mao Huang.
translations.idiomatic: It needed no borrowed elegance from swaying sleeves, nor any borrowed artifice from the dancer Mao Huang.

sentences.zh: 婉脊投頌，俯膺合雅。

translations.literal: Graceful spine casting praise, bowing chest matching elegant music.
translations.idiomatic: With supple back it answered the hymn, and bowing its chest it kept time with the elegant air.

sentences.zh: 露沫歕紅，沾汗流赭。

translations.literal: Foam showing red, sweat-stained flowing ochre.
translations.idiomatic: Foam flecked red at its lips, and sweat ran ochre down its flanks.

sentences.zh: 乃卻走於集靈，馴惠養於豊夏。

translations.literal: Then it withdrew running to Jiling, tamed and nurtured in Fengxia.
translations.idiomatic: Then it withdrew to Jiling, where it was gently broken and kept through the summer.

sentences.zh: 鬱風雷之壯心，思展足於南野。

translations.literal: Brooding a wind-and-thunder heroic heart, thinking to stretch its hooves on the southern wilds.
translations.idiomatic: Its heart swelled like wind and thunder, longing to stretch its legs across the southern fields.

sentences.zh: 若彼符瑞之富，可以臻介丘而昭卒業，搢紳羣后，誠希末光，天子深穆爲度，未之訪也。

translations.literal: If those auspicious omens are abundant, one could reach Jieqiu and display the completed enterprise; girded sashes and assembled lords truly hope for trailing light—the Son of Heaven, deep and solemn in measure, has not yet been consulted on this.
translations.idiomatic: With such abundance of auspicious signs, one might ascend Mount Tai to proclaim the completed work, and officials and feudal lords would indeed crave even a reflected share of its glory; yet the Son of Heaven, grave and restrained in his conduct, had not yet been approached about it.

sentences.zh: 何則？

translations.literal: Why is this?
translations.idiomatic: Why was that?

sentences.zh: 進讓殊事，豈非帝者之彌文哉。

translations.literal: Advancing and deferring are different matters—is this not the emperor's refined culture?
translations.idiomatic: To press forward and to yield are different matters—is this not the very refinement befitting an emperor?

sentences.zh: 今四衛外封，五岳內郡，宜弘下禪之規，增上封之訓，背清都而日行，指雲郊而玄運。

translations.literal: Now with the four guards sealing the outer realm and the five peaks as inner commanderies, one should expand the regulations of the ceding rite and augment the instruction of the ascending rite, turning one's back on the clear capital and proceeding by day, pointing to the clouded suburb and moving in dark rotation.
